text:
Marie (AE): Uploaded the pen-test evidence bundle for the Acme deal — wanted to loop engineering & legal. link: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/acme/1749903210-supplychain-bundle.zip :package:
Daniel (SecEng): thanks — I pulled the bundle. quick summary: one high CVSS vuln in a third-party JSON parser (CVE-2025-1428) used by our ingestion pipeline, plus two medium findings (dependency version skews). exploit PoC included but redacted in the public bundle.
Sam (Solutions): @Daniel can you confirm if this affects the hosted inference path or only the ingest preprocessor for Dedicated/Private customers?
Daniel (SecEng): only the ingest preprocessor for now (affects jobs that run model input normalization). hosted realtime path unaffected. impact: data exfil risk during batch job window.
Ellie (CSM): Customer asked for timeline and mitigation steps to include in their vendor review doc. they want an ETA for patch + compensating controls by EOD Friday.
Daniel (SecEng): proposed plan:
- Immediate: deploy WAF rule to block malformed JSON payloads + rate-limit suspect endpoints (owner: infra-sre) — today, within 4 hours.
- Short term: roll patched parser v2.3.1 to canary (10% traffic) — target T+3 days.
- Full rollout: 100% within T+10 days assuming canary stable.
- Post rollout: automated scan + regression run and new golden prompt tests (owner: seceng + qa).
Sam (Solutions): I'll attach a minimal config snippet for the WAF rule the customer can mirror on their side.
security-bot: evidence-bundle uploaded by marie (size: 12.3MB). checksum (sha256): 9d8f3a6b2f4c3a7fbb0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2
Marie (AE): sharing verification commands for legal/review: ```
# verify checksum
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-evidence/acme/1749903210-supplychain-bundle.zip ./bundle.zip
sha256sum bundle.zip
```
Rose (Legal): We need the PoC fully redacted in any customer-facing deliverable. also add a short statement on data exposure scope for contract addendum. I'll draft language once SecEng confirms scope.
Daniel (SecEng): agreed. PoC removed from the public S3 link; internal-only copy in secure vault (audit log id: vault/2025/4521). For customer: sanitized technical brief + timeline.
Ellie (CSM): Customer asked if there will be any downtime during patch window. Sam/Daniel?
Sam (Solutions): no scheduled downtime. canary patching is rolling; we have fallback route to previous parser image and automatic rollback if error rate exceeds 0.5% in canary.
Daniel (SecEng): risk acceptance options for customer: (A) accept compensating controls + canary schedule (faster), (B) wait for full patch validation (slower). Need customer sign-off on choice.
Marie (AE): I'll ask the customer to pick option A or B by EOD Thursday so we can meet their internal vendor review.
Ellie (CSM): also requested CVSS details and exploitability rating — @Daniel can you paste the scoring table from the report?
Daniel (SecEng): CVSS v3.1 vector: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N = 8.8 (High). I'll export the small table to the sanitized brief.
Rose (Legal): add note: we will provide indemnity language limited to documented exposure window and confirmed remediation date. drafting now.
Marie (AE): next actions for thread: 1) SecEng: finalize sanitized brief + timeline (by T+1 day). 2) Solutions: WAF rule snippet and rollback plan (today). 3) Legal: draft addendum language (48h). 4) Me/CSM: share to customer & collect sign-off (EOD Thu).
Sam (Solutions): putting WAF snippet below (for customer mirror):
```json
{
  "rule_name": "block-malformed-json-ingest",
  "condition": "!isValidJson(request.body)",
  "action": "block",
  "rate_limit": {"requests": 100, "interval": "1m"}
}
```
Daniel (SecEng): noted owners. I'll also attach a short mitigation verification checklist the customer can run once we push the canary.
Ellie (CSM): customer also asked for signing the evidence receipt — can someone upload a signed acceptance PDF after they confirm?
Marie (AE): yes, we'll upload signed docs to the S3 path and add to the contract package.
security-bot: reminder: evidence bucket access was granted to acme-security@acme.com for 7 days.
Marie (AE): thanks team — I'll update the customer now and ping when they reply. :thumbsup:
